class.name: IfcDoorStandardCase
class.brief_description: The standard door, IfcDoorStandardCase , defines a door with certain constraints for the provision of operation types, opening directions, frame and lining parameters, and with certain constraints for the geometric representation. The IfcDoorStandardCase handles all cases of doors, that: are inserted into an opening, represented by IfcOpeningElement , using the IfcRelFillsElement relationship have
